resolution: The req_0610 demolition order's scope clarification — docs/game/*.md ARE the kill list — is incorporated verbatim into §0.1 of the structure review (commit 2e2f7841f): a 30-row table mapping every per-cart markdown to its cart path, each verified on disk, with the non-cart meta docs (DECISIONS, GUIDING_LIGHT, STRUCTURE, BUILDING-GRAMMAR, REQUESTS, RLE_FORMAT, PLATMOD_PLAN, bake-geometry, physics3d, hmsc-int) explicitly excluded, and the per-cart docs + _index records scheduled for archive-tier retirement in the same commit as the deletion per the maintenance contract.
